business_problem: MSI Reproductive Choices (MSI) started in 1976 as a single clinic in London. Today, it opens doors to reproductive healthcare in 36 countries on 6 continents, overcoming the challenges that come with serving in remote geographies with language differences and limited medical supplies. By making reproductive choice possible and more accessible, MSI and its partners and donors are helping increase gender equality, break cycles of poverty, and meet sustainable development goals.
solution_summary: MSI Reproductive Choices (MSI) started in 1976 as a single clinic in London. Today, it opens doors to reproductive healthcare in 36 countries on 6 continents, overcoming the challenges that come with serving in remote geographies with language differences and limited medical supplies. MSI chose Dynamics 365 Customer Service and Customer Voice to leverage each point of client contact and optimize customer relationship management to provide the highest levels of continuous care. MSI’s implementation has driven increased collaboration and efficiency with more accurate and more timely data, and a higher quality of care for its clients.

metrics: MSI chose Dynamics 365 Customer Service and Customer Voice to leverage each point of client contact and optimize customer relationship management to provide the highest levels of continuous care.

MSI’s Client Contact Centers play a pivotal role in the client journey before, during, and after service delivery, fielding millions of calls and messages a year from clients in 19 countries and regions.

To maximize the benefit of each instance of contact and equip staff and providers with high-quality data to help women determine their best course of care, MSI chose Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Service and Customer Voice

MSI considered other solutions for its contact centers, but only Dynamics 365 Customer Service easily integrates with many other proprietary components and systems that are used in contact centers and more, including phone and hospital record systems, thereby simplifying MSI’s technology stack and reducing operating costs.
In 2018, roughly 350 contact center employees handled 1.5 million conversations.

In 2023, with staffing down by a third and a client base that had grown by 20%, the contact centers managed more than 3.77 million conversations—more than double the number from 2018 with just two-thirds of the staff.
